summary: Configured node1 as a persistent HTTP forward proxy on TCP 3128 and node2 as the persistent legacy handbook origin on TCP 8081. Only node2 may access the proxy; only the node2:8081 origin is permitted. Other ports and all CONNECT tunnels return 403. Both nodes restarted individually and fully recovered.
actions_performed: Created and enabled the legacy handbook origin systemd service on node2.
Applied peer-restricted persistent firewalld rules for ports 3128 and 8081.
Configured deny-by-default Squid ACLs with explicit CONNECT denial.
Verified the proxied handbook matches the preserved source SHA-256.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Approved handbook is preserved and reachable through the proxy from node2
evidence.summary: Proxy returned HTTP 200 and the retrieved handbook SHA-256 matched the staged source before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Only node2:8081 is permitted; other ports and CONNECT tunnels are rejected
evidence.summary: Port 80 and CONNECT requests returned 403; Squid logs record TCP_DENIED while approved requests record TCP_MISS/200.

evidence.requirement: Persistent proxy and origin services with restricted network exposure
evidence.summary: Services are enabled and active, listeners are present, configuration parses successfully, and persistent firewall rules restrict each port to its peer node.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64.
